title: KC vs KOI pour une place en playoffs des Worlds 2026
content:
Le destin a réservé un scénario particulièrement intéressant aux représentants européens. Après avoir éliminé CTBC Flying Oyster (2-0) pour revenir à 2-2 dans le Swiss Stage, la Karmine Corp retrouvera Movistar KOI dans un BO3 décisif pour la qualification en quarts de finale. Un tirage qui devrait ravir Caliste, lequel avait justement désigné la formation espagnole comme son adversaire préféré pour cette dernière rencontre. De son côté, KOI devra rebondir après sa lourde défaite face à T1 (0-2) lors du quatrième round.

L’enjeu est immense pour les deux formations. Avec l’élimination de G2 Esports face à Hanwha Life (0-2), l’Europe a perdu l’un de ses principaux favoris, mais elle est désormais assurée de compter au moins un représentant dans le Top 8 mondial. Pour la KC, ce serait une nouvelle étape majeure dans son parcours international, tandis que KOI espère confirmer sa place parmi les meilleures équipes de la compétition. Une chose est certaine : au terme de ce duel fratricide, une équipe européenne poursuivra son aventure, tandis que l’autre devra faire ses valises.

Mais l’affiche la plus prestigieuse de ce dernier round opposera Hanwha Life Esports à Bilibili Gaming. Les Coréens arrivent lancés après leur démonstration face à G2, portée notamment par les excellentes prestations de Kanavi et Gumayusi. En face, BLG se retrouve dos au mur après sa défaite contre Top Esports (1-2). Deux formations annoncées parmi les grandes prétendantes au titre mondial se disputeront donc un unique billet pour les quarts de finale, avec une élimination particulièrement douloureuse pour le perdant.

Enfin, LOS et LYON compléteront le programme de ce cinquième round, dans une confrontation entre deux équipes qui ont déjà déjoué plusieurs pronostics. Les Brésiliens viennent notamment de créer la surprise en éliminant Team Liquid (2-1), première tête de série nord-américaine, tandis que LYON tentera de prolonger son aventure après sa défaite contre Invictus Gaming. Les trois rencontres se disputeront ce samedi en BO3, avec une qualification en quarts de finale pour les vainqueurs et une élimination définitive pour les perdants. Les horaires exacts des matchs n’ont pas encore été annoncés.

title: « La LCK le dit elle-même » : la Karmine Corp fait parler jusqu’en Corée
content:
Dos au mur après deux défaites frustrantes contre LYON et Bilibili Gaming, la Karmine Corp a parfaitement réagi face à CTBC Flying Oyster. Un succès précieux, marqué par une deuxième manche particulièrement compliquée, mais qui permet aux Français de revenir à 2-2 dans le Swiss Stage. Interrogé par nos confrères de DPM Esports , Caliste a reconnu les difficultés rencontrées sur la botlane, tout en saluant la réaction collective de son équipe. « Ce genre de partie peut arriver, et réussir à renverser la situation montre beaucoup de bonnes choses sur un groupe. » Une victoire qui redonne confiance à la KC avant son ultime BO3, décisif pour une qualification en quarts de finale.

Mais le jeune ADC français voit surtout beaucoup plus loin. Malgré les deux revers concédés dans ce Swiss Stage, Caliste estime que la Karmine Corp possède les armes pour rivaliser avec les meilleures formations du monde. Et les retours des équipes coréennes à l’entraînement semblent lui donner raison. « Nous savons que nous pouvons aller très, très loin. Je pense que ce sont les équipes de LCK qui le disent elles-mêmes. Nous pouvons être une équipe vraiment dangereuse » , assure-t-il. Selon lui, la KC affiche en scrims un visage particulièrement agressif, avec une excellente phase de lane et une capacité à prendre des risques qui surprendrait plusieurs adversaires asiatiques. Reste désormais à reproduire ce niveau sur scène, où la pression et les erreurs d’exécution ont parfois coûté très cher aux Français.

Un optimisme également partagé par Canna, particulièrement confiant après la victoire contre CFO. Dans une interview accordée au média sud-coréen Inven Global , le toplaner estime que son équipe a encore progressé ces derniers jours. « Notre niveau en scrims s’est encore amélioré récemment. L’équipe a trouvé un très bon équilibre. Même si nous comptons actuellement deux défaites, ce sont des matchs que nous aurions largement pu remporter. » Le Coréen pointe notamment les erreurs commises lors de certains combats d’équipe, mais refuse de voir une limite au potentiel de la KC : « Si nous soignons un peu notre exécution, je pense qu’il n’y a aucune équipe que nous ne pouvons pas battre. »

Pour franchir cette dernière marche, la Karmine Corp entend notamment simplifier ses drafts et privilégier des conditions de victoire plus claires, comme l’explique Caliste. Le Français ne cache pas non plus sa préférence pour Movistar KOI lors du tirage au sort, qu’il considère comme l’adversaire le plus abordable parmi les équipes encore en course. Canna, de son côté, préférerait éviter une formation de LCK avant les quarts de finale. Mais quel que soit l’adversaire, le message est clair : la KC croit toujours en ses chances de réaliser un grand parcours aux Worlds 2026, et compte bien prouver sur scène que les performances remarquées à l’entraînement ne doivent rien au hasard.

title: Razer Naga V3 Pro review: An MMO mouse built for versatility
content:
Released this year, the Razer Naga V3 Pro is a mouse built for massively multiplayer online (MMO) titles. It features programmable buttons, double-shot molded keycaps, swappable side plates, Razer Optical Mouse Switches Gen-4 switches, and so much more. Esports.gg received the Razer Naga V3 Pro and the Razer HyperFlux V2 Wireless Charging System for review. Read on for a closer look at each product’s best features.

One of the first things that stands out about the Razer Naga V3 Pro is how naturally it sits in our hand. Players who have previously used mice with a third mouse button or MMO-style mice should feel right at home.

Despite everything packed into the mouse, the weight distribution feels balanced. This helps keep the mouse comfortable during longer World of Warcraft sessions. Additionally, the side buttons sit naturally where our thumb rests. This makes them easy to reach without having to awkwardly reposition our hand.

The ability to swap the side plates and have them snap securely into place is appreciated, too. They’re great when we want to swap to different games that require a different layout.

Other details include the satisfying sound of the mouse wheel’s scrolling options, Razer’s Gen-4 optical switches for fast, consistent clicks, plus support for Bluetooth and wireless charging.

On this note, wireless charging is one of our favorite features when paired with the Razer HyperFlux V2 Wireless Charging System . We no longer need to set our mouse aside to charge it via a cable or replace batteries.

title: Discord’s IPO Has Stalled As Investors Can’t Agree What It’s Worth
content:
Discord filed confidentially for a US IPO in January, and people familiar with the plan told Bloomberg it was aiming to debut in March, TechCrunch reported . Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan were hired to run the offering. Ten months after the filing, the chat app is still private, and its paperwork still hasn’t been made public.

The stalled Discord IPO has left its investors to put their own prices on the company, and their numbers are far apart. Fund reports filed with the SEC in recent weeks, along with prices from the secondary market where early shareholders sell to new buyers, value a Discord share at anywhere from $23.51 to $36.79. Every one of those figures is below the $55.06 a share Discord charged in 2021, when a $500 million round valued it at about $15 billion.

A listing can’t happen quickly from here. Under SEC rules, a company that files in private has to make its registration statement public at least 15 days before it starts pitching the shares to investors. Discord hadn’t done that by 30 October, so an IPO is weeks away at the earliest, and no new date has been reported. Discord hasn’t said why the March target slipped.

Fidelity has the lowest number. Its Growth Company Fund holds 70,000 Discord Series I preferred shares, bought in September 2021 for $3.85 million, and valued them at $1.65 million on 31 August, its quarterly holdings report shows . That works out to $23.51 a share, 57% below what Fidelity paid, and other Fidelity funds that own the shares use the same price. The low mark isn’t new. Fidelity’s funds already valued the stake at less than half its cost in August 2023, and the latest figure is a little higher than the $22.28 they used in the spring.

ARK Venture Fund is close behind. Its annual report for the year to 31 July values its 176,670 Discord common shares at $4.68 million, or about $26.51 each, according to the filing . ARK bought them in November 2022 for $4.37 million, so its holding sits about 7% above cost.

The secondary market is more generous. Forge , which tracks trades in private company shares, put Discord’s indicative price at $36.79 on 30 October, up 17% in six months, and values the company at $10.02 billion at that price. That is 56% above Fidelity’s mark and about a third below the 2021 round.

title: G2 NORD remporte son duel avec Galions pour une pépite de la LFL
content:
Le mercato commence à s’animer dans les ligues régionales européennes de League of Legends. Selon les informations de Sheep Esports , Mario « Exofeng » Emilov Strugov aurait trouvé un accord avec G2 NORD pour la saison 2027. Âgé de seulement 19 ans, le botlaner bulgare sort d’un Summer Split convaincant avec Skillcamp en LFL, où il a notamment atteint le top 4 des playoffs avant de s’incliner face à la Karmine Corp Blue. Il a également découvert les EMEA Masters, avec une élimination en huitièmes de finale contre cette même équipe.

Mais G2 NORD n’était pas seul sur le dossier. Galions souhaitait également recruter Exofeng, et les deux structures se seraient livré une véritable bataille pour obtenir sa signature. Après plusieurs discussions, le joueur aurait finalement choisi de rejoindre l’académie de G2 mercredi soir. Il devrait ainsi succéder à Khalil « Rin » Sahraoui, titulaire tout au long de la saison 2026 et vainqueur du Spring Split de Prime League. Pour Exofeng, ce transfert marquerait un retour en Allemagne, quelques mois après son passage chez Kaufland Hangry Knights, où il n’était pas parvenu à atteindre les playoffs.

Cette arrivée constituerait la première pièce du nouvel effectif de G2 NORD, dont l’ensemble des joueurs et du staff arrive en fin de contrat à la mi-novembre. Pour sa première année en tant qu’équipe académique, la structure a pourtant réalisé une saison particulièrement solide : finaliste des Winter et Summer Splits de Prime League face à Berlin International Gaming, elle a surtout remporté le Spring Split contre Eintracht Spandau. Sur la scène européenne, G2 NORD a également participé aux trois éditions des EMEA Masters, atteignant les quarts de finale au printemps et en été.

Ce recrutement illustre aussi la concurrence grandissante entre les organisations les plus ambitieuses des ERL. G2 NORD, Galions, UCAM et la Karmine Corp Blue figurent parmi les rares structures disposant de moyens importants à avoir déjà lancé leur reconstruction pour 2027. Tandis que KCB devrait promouvoir une grande partie de son équipe issue du troisième échelon, G2 NORD et Galions se disputent plusieurs profils prometteurs. Avec Exofeng, l’académie de G2 semble avoir remporté une première bataille importante, en attendant de découvrir le reste de son effectif.

title: Forza Creator Dan Greenawalt Retires From Microsoft After 27 Years
content:
Dan Greenawalt, who founded Turn 10 Studios and led the creation of Forza, is retiring from Microsoft after 27 years. Trevor Williams, the head of Playground Games, told staff in an internal memo that The Verge’s Tom Warren reported on 29 October. “Dan Greenawalt has decided that this is the right time for him to retire from Microsoft,” Williams wrote, Shacknews reported . “It’s hard to overstate Dan’s impact over the past 27 years.”

He won’t leave straight away. Greenawalt will first advise Michel Bastien, Playground’s new chief operating officer, before he formally leaves the company. Williams thanked him in the memo for “his leadership, his support, and his partnership.”

Five weeks earlier, Xbox folded Turn 10, which is based near Seattle, into Playground Games, the studio in Leamington Spa, England, that makes Forza Horizon. The Redmond team now works as Playground Games Redmond and helps make Forza Horizon and Fable, Pure Xbox reported . Forza Motorsport, the series Greenawalt started, hasn’t had an update since 2025, and Microsoft hasn’t said whether it will get another game.

Greenawalt started at Microsoft as a test engineer on its early racing games, including Midtown Madness, RalliSport Challenge and Project Gotham Racing, according to The Drive . He founded Turn 10 inside Microsoft in 2001, the year the original Xbox launched. The first Forza Motorsport came out on the original Xbox in 2005. He directed it and the next three games, Forza Motorsport 2 in 2007, Forza Motorsport 3 in 2009 and Forza Motorsport 4 in 2011, which took the series through the Xbox 360 years. He later moved into a wider creative director role covering the franchise.

Turn 10’s ForzaTech engine, first built for those games, has run every Forza Horizon game since the first one in 2012, and it also powers Playground’s Fable, GTPlanet noted. Greenawalt didn’t direct Horizon himself, but the first Horizon was built on the technology and car content from his Motorsport games, The Drive pointed out.

Turn 10 kept releasing Motorsport games for another decade after he stepped back from directing them. Forza Motorsport 5 launched with the Xbox One in 2013, followed by Forza Motorsport 6 in 2015, the PC-only Forza Motorsport 6: Apex in 2016 and Forza Motorsport 7 in 2017. The most recent game, a reboot simply called Forza Motorsport, came out on Xbox Series X|S and PC in 2023.

title: Take-Two Files 16 Vice City Trademarks Three Weeks Before GTA 6
content:
Take-Two Interactive filed 16 US trademark applications on 28 October for Vice City, the city at the centre of Grand Theft Auto 6, and for related names. The game comes out on 19 November. The applications to the US Patent and Trademark Office cover everything from game software to lighters, and we found no earlier report of them.

Ten are for “Vice City” on its own, without the Grand Theft Auto name. Four are for “Vice City Leonida”, which pairs the city with Leonida, the fictional state GTA 6 is set in. The other two cover the Grand Theft Auto name and the Rockstar Games logo. Andrea L. Calvaruso of Kelley Drye & Warren, who handles Take-Two’s trademark filings, filed all 16, and each is waiting to be assigned to an examiner. The filings arrive three weeks before Take-Two’s most anticipated release in years, and they would protect the city’s name on its own, apart from the Grand Theft Auto brand.

The Vice City application for game software claims first use on 29 October 2002, the day Grand Theft Auto: Vice City came out in North America. A matching filing for online games and other entertainment services claims the same date. Both are use-based, so Take-Two is asking for registration on the grounds that it has used the name for 24 years.

The other Vice City applications fall in the classes for jewellery, printed matter, bags, housewares, clothing, toys and lighters. The trademark system sorts goods into numbered classes, and a mark only protects the classes it is registered in. Filing across this many is how a company makes sure a name is covered wherever it plans to sell it.

Several of the use-based filings give a much more recent first-use date. The Vice City clothing application, for shirts, sweatshirts, jackets and caps, lists 8 October 2026. So do the Vice City lighter filing, the Grand Theft Auto bags filing and the Rockstar Games filing for printed materials. That was the day Rockstar opened its GTA 6 collection on the Rockstar Store, with T-shirts, caps, canvas bags, a Vice City Zippo lighter and sticker sets.

TalkEsport has the full price list . Take-Two started selling the products first and filed for the trademarks three weeks later, citing the store launch as its first use. Take-Two filed the four Vice City Leonida applications on an intent-to-use basis, which means it hasn’t sold anything under that name yet. They cover sunglasses , bags, printed guides, and the class for jewellery and watches. The printed-guides filing lists “manuals, pamphlets, booklets, books, magazines, posters, stickers, and guides” about game strategy, wording broad enough to cover an official strategy guide.

title: LEC : Hype accepte de baisser son salaire pour rester chez Heretics
content:
Le mercato de Team Heretics prend une tournure intéressante. Selon les informations de Sheep Esports , Byeon « Hype » Jeong-hyeon aurait accepté une réduction de salaire pour poursuivre l’aventure avec la structure espagnole en 2027. Pourtant sous contrat jusqu’en 2028, le botlaner de 23 ans n’était pas assuré de conserver sa place dans le cinq de départ. L’organisation envisageait en effet de recruter un autre ADC si aucun terrain d’entente n’était trouvé sur ses conditions salariales. Les deux parties seraient finalement parvenues à un accord, permettant à Hype de rester titulaire la saison prochaine.

Cette renégociation aurait surtout permis à Heretics de débloquer une partie de son mercato. La baisse de salaire de Hype aurait facilité les discussions avec Iván « Razork » Martín Díaz, que l’organisation souhaite intégrer à son nouveau projet. Reste désormais à savoir si cette nouvelle formule permettra à Heretics de retrouver les premiers rôles. L’arrivée potentielle de Razork et le maintien de Hype témoignent en tout cas d’une volonté claire de construire un effectif plus ambitieux, tout en maîtrisant les dépenses. Après plusieurs saisons difficiles, la pression sera importante sur ce nouveau projet, dont les premiers contours commencent à se dessiner. title: Fidelity Cuts Epic Games Valuation by 47% in a Year
content:
Fidelity has cut its valuation of Epic Games shares by 47% in a year, according to fund holdings reports filed with the US Securities and Exchange Commission on 26 October. The asset manager now puts the Fortnite maker’s stock at $368.37 a share, down from $700.58 at the end of August 2025. When Fidelity first invested, in July 2020, it paid $575.

Fidelity holds Epic in several of its funds, and every report TalkEsport checked uses the same price for 31 August 2026. The largest stake we found sits in the Fidelity Growth Company Fund , which owns 51,800 Epic shares valued at $19.08 million. It paid $29.8 million for them. The Fidelity Advisor Equity Growth Fund bought later, in March 2021, at $885 a share, so its holding is now worth 58% less than it cost.

The decline has been steady. The Growth Company K6 Fund valued its Epic shares at $700.58 in its report for August 2025 , then at $510.41 in February. Fidelity’s semiannual report put them at $441.44 at the end of May, and the August figure is 28% below February’s.

Fidelity’s numbers trace a full round trip. The round it joined in 2020 raised $1.78 billion and valued Epic at $17.3 billion, Bloomberg reported at the time. In April 2021 Epic raised another $1 billion at a $28.7 billion valuation, with Sony putting in $200 million and Fidelity Management & Research again among the investors . A year later Sony and KIRKBI, the Lego family’s holding company, put in $1 billion each at a valuation of $31.5 billion, TechCrunch reported.

Disney’s $1.5 billion investment in February 2024 came at a lower price. Disney didn’t state a valuation, but Reuters, citing The Information, put the implied figure at about $22.5 billion and said Fidelity, T. Rowe Price and BlackRock had recently marked their Epic stakes at roughly the price Disney paid.

Fidelity’s mark is now 36% below what it paid in 2020. The filings don’t give a figure for the whole company, but one can be estimated. Disney paid $600 a share in 2024 in a deal that valued Epic at $22.5 billion, according to Forge , which tracks trades in private company shares. At that share count, Fidelity’s $368.37 mark works out to about $13.8 billion by TalkEsport’s calculation, down from roughly $26.3 billion a year earlier. The estimate assumes Epic hasn’t issued many new shares since then.

title: Joblife, Mandatory, NAVI… les premières équipes invitées aux qualifications du VCT EMEA 2027
content:
Le nouveau format compétitif de VALORANT commence à prendre forme en Europe. Alors que seulement huit organisations bénéficieront du statut de partenaire en VCT EMEA pour le cycle 2027-2028, quatre équipes supplémentaires pourront participer au Kickoff grâce aux qualifications régionales. Deux places seront attribuées à la zone Europe, tandis que les deux dernières reviendront aux qualifications MENA et Türkiye. Le tournoi européen réunira 16 formations : huit directement invitées en playoffs et huit autres issues des Open Qualifiers.

Parmi les équipes invitées figurent désormais Joblife, Mandatory, l’Eintracht Francfort, Natus Vincere, UCAM Esports et MIR. Les deux premières structures françaises nourrissent de grandes ambitions, tandis qu’Eintracht Frankfurt avait également réussi à se qualifier pour les Play-Ins du VCT EMEA Stage 2 en 2026. De son côté, NAVI, qui ne bénéficiera plus du statut de partenaire la saison prochaine, poursuivra l’aventure avec son ancienne équipe académique, NAVI Junior. UCAM représentera le circuit espagnol, tandis que MIR tentera de confirmer ses progrès après deux saisons en VCL NORTH//EAST. Deux autres invitations restent encore à préciser.

Le calendrier est déjà fixé. Les Open Qualifiers débuteront le 5 novembre, avec huit places à décrocher pour rejoindre les formations invitées. Les 16 participants devront être connus au plus tard le 15 novembre, avant le lancement des playoffs européens le 25 novembre. La compétition se poursuivra jusqu’au 5 décembre, date à laquelle les deux représentants européens qualifiés pour le Kickoff seront déterminés. Ce format a récemment été revu par Riot Games après les critiques de la communauté.

Pour Joblife et Mandatory, l’enjeu sera particulièrement important. Après avoir marqué les esprits en 2026, notamment en éliminant Fnatic de la course aux playoffs et aux Champions, Joblife prépare sa nouvelle campagne avec les arrivées de hoody et al0rante. De son côté, Mandatory a frappé un grand coup sur le mercato en officialisant un effectif international composé de starxo, MiniBoo, Kicks, runneR et Veqaj. Deux projets ambitieux qui tenteront de bousculer la hiérarchie européenne, mais la concurrence promet d’être féroce : seules deux formations décrocheront leur billet pour le premier grand rendez-vous de 2027.

Une reconstruction presque totale pour la structure française, qui s’est séparée de l’ensemble de son précédent effectif après une saison marquée par une qualification aux Masters Santiago.

Toutes les équipes n’ont cependant pas encore dévoilé leurs intentions. Même constat chez Vitality, finaliste des Champions 2026, qui devra notamment trouver un successeur à Derke. Les deux structures françaises pourraient donc encore réserver plusieurs surprises dans les prochaines semaines.

title: Netflix Is Making a Live-Action PUBG Series With Donald Glover
content:
Netflix is developing a live-action series based on PUBG: Battlegrounds, and Donald Glover is attached to write, direct, executive produce and star. Netflix and Krafton, the South Korean company that owns the game, announced the project on 29 October, with TheWrap among the first to carry it. His brother Stephen Glover, a writer on Atlanta, will write and executive produce, Gematsu reported .

Beyond those names, the Netflix PUBG series has no plot, setting, release window or cast yet. What’s on Netflix reports that the scripts haven’t been written, and its own estimate is that the show won’t reach the service before 2028.

Netflix’s announcement, as quoted by Gizmodo, called PUBG “the best-selling game from Krafton that globally popularized the battle royale genre” and “a global cultural icon with seven Guinness World Records”. Krafton said the series is part of a push to “expand the franchise beyond gaming into original entertainment content”.

Most game adaptations that have worked on screen started with people. HBO’s The Last of Us had Joel and Ellie. Arcane, which won the Emmy for outstanding animated program in 2022, had Vi and Jinx. PUBG has nobody. It drops up to 100 players onto an island, they scavenge for weapons while a shrinking circle forces them together, and the last player or squad alive wins. Every character in the show will have to be invented.

The premise isn’t new either. PUBG grew out of the battle royale mods Brendan Greene made for Arma, and the genre takes its name from the 2000 Japanese film Battle Royale. Strangers fighting to be the last one standing has been on screen many times since, The Hunger Games included, so a straight retelling would land in crowded territory. Prime Video’s Fallout is a better model: it kept the world and the tone of the games and wrote new characters into them.

Nothing in Glover’s record suggests a straight action show. Atlanta, the FX series he created, won him two Emmys in 2017, for lead actor in a comedy and for directing a comedy, according to the Television Academy , which lists 14 nominations for him in total. That year Atlanta also won the Golden Globe for best musical or comedy series, and Glover won the Globe for best actor. The show often left its main characters behind for standalone episodes, especially in its third season, and it rarely did what viewers expected.

title: Overwatch ranks in order (2026): Full rank list and SR explained
content:
Overwatch has 10 competitive ranks starting at Bronze and ending with Top 500 Challenger. Here are all Overwatch ranks in order plus their SR ranges and how the ranked system works in 2026.

The competitive ranks in Overwatch show where you stand on the Competitive Play ladder. Players progress through the Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Emerald, Diamond, Master, Grandmaster, and Champion tiers, and only the best of best are in the Top 500 Challenger rank.

Each Overwatch rank has five divisions going from 5 to 1. Division 5 is the lowest within a rank while Division 1 is the highest. For example, Platinum 5 is the lowest Platinum rank while Platinum 1 is the highest.

Winning Competitive matches increases your rank progress while losing can decrease it. Top 500 Challenger works differently and uses leaderboard placement and Challenger Score instead of the standard division system.

In Overwatch, your rank is determined by your Hero Skill Rating (HSR). This is more commonly known as just “SR” by players.

Winning Competitive matches increases your SR and rank progress while losing can decrease it. Top 500 Challenger uses Challenger Score and leaderboard placement instead of the standard SR divisions.

La tête d’affiche de cette nouvelle équipe sera évidemment Nikita « Derke » Sirmitev, récemment libéré par Vitality après deux saisons sous ses couleurs. B1SK et Chiwa viennent compléter cet effectif, qui mêle joueurs confirmés et profils prometteurs.

title: GTA 6 Map Size Could Be As Big As GTA 4, GTA 5 and RDR2 Combined

The essence of GTA games has often extended beyond the scope of their storylines, which makes the details across the map all the more important for players. title: RLCS : Gentle Mates officialise son trio de rêve avec zen, Vatira et Atow
content:
Le feuilleton de l’intersaison touche enfin à sa fin. Ce mercredi soir, Gentle Mates a officialisé le recrutement d’Alexis « zen » Bernier, Axel « Vatira » Touret et Tristan « Atow » Soyez, donnant naissance à une véritable super-équipe francophone. Un trio dont l’association faisait rêver une partie de la communauté depuis plusieurs mois, mais dont la concrétisation était loin d’être acquise. Gentle Mates a dû livrer une bataille particulièrement intense face à la Karmine Corp et Vitality, également déterminées à attirer ces trois stars. Les négociations auraient été marquées par une importante surenchère et plusieurs tensions en coulisses, avant que le club fondé par Squeezie, Brawks et Gotaga ne parvienne à convaincre les joueurs.

LES 3 MONSTRES SONT ENFIN RÉUNIS ! Souhaitez la bienvenue à notre roster Rocket League #M8WIN pic.twitter.com/LAvvqCw2a6

Ce transfert marque également la fin de deux aventures emblématiques du Rocket League français. Arrivé chez Vitality en 2023, zen avait immédiatement bouleversé la hiérarchie mondiale, remportant les Championnats du monde dès sa première saison professionnelle. De son côté, Vatira quitte la Karmine Corp après quatre années durant lesquelles il est devenu le véritable visage de la section Rocket League, avec notamment trois Majors remportés. Atow, son coéquipier depuis 2024, apporte lui aussi une immense expérience du très haut niveau, après avoir notamment remporté l’Esports World Cup 2025 sous les couleurs de la KC.

Sur le papier, Gentle Mates possède désormais l’un des effectifs les plus impressionnants de l’histoire de Rocket League. Les trois joueurs, déjà habitués à évoluer ensemble ou à se retrouver sur les plus grandes scènes internationales, devront toutefois transformer cette accumulation de talents en résultats. Car les attentes seront immenses autour d’une formation qui ne pourra raisonnablement viser autre chose que les plus grands trophées.

La concurrence s’annonce d’ailleurs particulièrement relevée en France. Dans la foulée de ces départs, la Karmine Corp a officialisé son nouveau projet autour de M0nkey M00n, bibbaba et reyyn, avec Extra toujours aux commandes. Vitality, de son côté, restera également engagée sur le circuit RLCS malgré le départ de sa star. Trois structures françaises, des effectifs profondément remaniés et une rivalité qui promet de faire des étincelles : la prochaine saison, dont le coup d’envoi est prévu à la mi-novembre, s’annonce déjà passionnante.

title: Nemiga’s win over FUT likely costs Astralis cmtry at the Major
content:
Under Valve’s rule for players listed on two Major rosters, Nemiga’s quarter-final win over FUT should keep cmtry on FUT’s list and out of Astralis’ lineup in Singapore, although none of the parties have confirmed it.

FUT Esports went out of PGL Masters Bucharest on Thursday morning, beaten 2-0 by Nemiga in the first quarter-final. The result matters as much in Barcelona as in Bucharest: it means SunPayus stays on four FUT matches, one short of the five that would have taken Mykyta “ cmtry ” Samolotov off FUT’s roster before Valve’s snapshot on 2 November.

FUT’s next match is against Spirit at BLAST Rivals on 11 November, nine days after the snapshot. Unless something changes in the registration, cmtry will still count as a FUT player when the Major invitations go out.

Valve explained the situation earlier this week in a reply that HLTV journalist Striker posted on X, and we went through it on Wednesday . If the same player appears on two invited rosters, the team with the higher VRS keeps him and the other team cannot take part. A player registered on one roster also cannot be registered as a coach or substitute for another.

FUT are above Astralis in the standings. Read together with Thursday’s result, the rule leaves Astralis without cmtry at the Major, not even as a substitute. Their lineup in Singapore should be the one that has played in Barcelona since Wednesday: jabbi , Staehr , phzy , ryu and siuhy , with NEO as coach.

James Banks was among the first to point this out after the quarter-final, writing on X that Astralis will play the Major with jabbi and not cmtry, and that SunPayus will likely play for FUT as a substitute but without a sticker.

title: Valve introduces big head mutators in Counter-Strike 2 alongside silent reload adjustments and leaked LAR rifle files
content:
Valve released a new update for Counter-Strike 2 last night. While the official patch notes focus on adjustments to the silent reload mechanic and minor bug fixes, backend changes discovered by dataminers reveal new casual mode modifiers and files for an unreleased rifle.

The main gameplay modification in the official changelog addresses how players execute silent reloads. Valve added a setting that allows users to switch the silent reload input between hold and toggle. With the toggle option enabled, players can release the reload key once the silent reload animation begins. If a player needs to abort the quiet reload and transition back to a standard fast reload, tapping the reload key a second time will cancel the action.

Alongside the input adjustment, the update resolves an audio defect. Previously, the initial sound cue of a weapon reload would occasionally play for nearby players regardless of whether a silent reload was initiated. This inconsistency has now been patched.

In the miscellaneous section of the patch notes, Valve fixed a rendering issue on AMD graphics cards where liquid surfaces appeared completely black. The developers also corrected multiple user interface and audio bugs triggered when rewinding footage during demo playback.

Beyond the official documentation, inspections of the game files by community dataminers Thour and Gabe Follower exposed new weapon assets. According to Thour, files and an inventory icon for a weapon designated as the LAR were added to the client with this patch.

Gabe Follower noted that this weapon is a renamed version of the previously leaked M14. The current files indicate that the LAR functions like a Winchester rifle, utilizing a per-bullet reloading mechanic. However, the materials for the weapon are currently stored inside a folder labeled “do_not_ship”, indicating that the firearm is still in development and not ready for public release.

title: Worlds 2026 : T1 et Invictus Gaming en quarts, KOI et LYON en 2-2
content:
Les champions du monde en titre n’ont pas tremblé. Opposé à Movistar KOI, T1 a survolé son BO3 pour s’imposer 2-0, porté notamment par un Doran impérial sur la toplane. Le Coréen a terminé la première manche avec un impressionnant 6/0/6 sur Ambessa, avant de récidiver sur Gwen (4/0/7). Une démonstration de force qui permet à T1 de rejoindre Dplus KIA et Gen.G en quarts de finale, devenant ainsi la troisième équipe coréenne qualifiée. Faker continue également d’écrire l’histoire, avec une onzième qualification pour les quarts de finale des Worlds, un record absolu dans la compétition.

Pour KOI, en revanche, la situation devient préoccupante. Après avoir débuté le Swiss Stage par deux victoires, les Espagnols viennent d’enchaîner deux défaites face à Dplus KIA et T1. Désormais en 2-2, ils devront impérativement remporter leur prochain BO3 pour poursuivre l’aventure. Une dernière chance de rejoindre le top 8 mondial, après avoir échoué à faire tomber deux des favoris coréens.

On offre tout à T1 pic.twitter.com/kTYgqGInk5

Dans l’autre rencontre de la soirée, Invictus Gaming a dû batailler pour venir à bout de LYON (2-1). Les Chinois ont d’abord écrasé la première manche en seulement 25 minutes, avec un sévère 19-4 au tableau d’affichage. Rookie s’est particulièrement illustré sur Aurora (8/1/8), pendant qu’Inspired est complètement passé à côté de sa partie avec Nocturne (1/6/1). Le jungler polonais s’est toutefois repris dans la deuxième manche, cette fois sur Qiyana (4/1/5), bien épaulé par un Dhokla agressif sur Olaf (4/2/3). De quoi permettre à LYON d’égaliser et d’arracher une manche décisive.

Mais la manche décisive a rapidement tourné à la démonstration. Dépassé dès la draft, LYON n’a jamais réussi à contenir la botlane chinoise, où JiaQi et Meiko ont fait vivre un véritable enfer à leurs adversaires. Impérial sur Caitlyn (5/1/2), JiaQi a même conclu la rencontre sur un triple kill, scellant la victoire d’Invictus Gaming en seulement 24 minutes. Les Chinois deviennent ainsi les premiers représentants de la LPL à décrocher leur billet pour les quarts de finale de ces Worlds 2026. Une qualification particulière pour TheShy et Rookie, qui se retrouvent ensemble dans le top 8 mondial huit ans après leur sacre historique sous les couleurs d’IG en 2018.

Pour LYON, la désillusion est immense. Après avoir parfaitement lancé leur tournoi avec deux victoires consécutives, les Américains ont enchaîné deux revers face à Gen.G et Invictus Gaming. En 2-2, ils se retrouvent dos au mur comme Movistar KOI. Les deux formations occidentales devront impérativement remporter leur dernier BO3 du Swiss Stage pour espérer rejoindre les quarts de finale.

title: Tencent Pentagon Blacklist: Impact on BGMI and India
content:
Tencent is still on the Pentagon’s list of Chinese military companies, and since June 30 the Tencent Pentagon blacklist has barred it from any contract with the US Department of Defense. On its own, the listing does nothing to BGMI, Valorant or any other Tencent-linked game in India. Washington’s restrictions govern what the US military buys and whom it signs contracts with. Tencent’s connection to Indian players runs through its investments, chiefly its stake in Krafton, the South Korean publisher behind Battlegrounds Mobile India (BGMI).

Tencent has been on the list for close to two years. It first appeared in a Federal Register notice published on January 7, 2025, and it stayed on the latest version of the list , which the Pentagon released in June this year. For India’s gaming industry, the open question is whether the US designation ever travels to New Delhi, or whether India decides to act against Tencent on its own.

The list comes from Section 1260H of the National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA) for 2021. It requires the Pentagon to name Chinese companies it considers tied to the People’s Liberation Army (PLA) that operate in the US, and to revise the list at least once a year until 2030. The June 2026 notice runs to 188 entities and gives a one-line reason for Tencent: the department says it is indirectly affiliated with the PLA.

Getting to that version was messy. The Pentagon published an update in February 2026, withdrew it from the Federal Register without explanation, and put out a near-identical list in June. Tencent was on the final roster, alongside Alibaba, Baidu, BYD and CATL.

Until this year, a 1260H listing was mostly a reputational problem. That changed on June 30, 2026, when Section 805 of the 2024 NDAA took effect. The Pentagon can no longer sign, renew or extend contracts with listed companies or the businesses they control, and from June 30, 2027 the ban widens to any goods or services that contain something those companies made. A second rule that started the same day bars the Pentagon from hiring contractors whose lobbyists also work for listed firms. Bloomberg reported that Tencent lost four Washington lobbying firms in the weeks after the June update.

Markets took the original listing seriously. Reuters reported that Tencent’s Hong Kong shares fell 7.3% the day after the January 2025 designation, erasing about HK$275 billion in market value. Tencent called its inclusion “a mistake”, said it is neither a military company nor a supplier, and promised to work with the department to clear up the misunderstanding. Close to two years later, it is still listed. Alibaba, added this June, has gone to court to get off.

title: jL on life after Singapore: “I might just call it quits”
content:
With a child on the way, the 2024 Copenhagen Major MVP says he would rather step away from pro Counter-Strike than sign a deal he does not believe in.

Justinas “ jL ” Lekavicius could leave professional Counter-Strike after the PGL Major Singapore if no team he wants to join comes in for him. The Lithuanian, who is standing in for Team Vitality at PGL Masters Bucharest 2026, told HLTV after Tuesday’s 2-0 win over NAVI that the Major is his cut-off point.

Ideally I would get a team and I could compete again for trophies, but if that doesn’t work out, it’s not the end of the world. To be honest, if I don’t find a team after Singapore, I might just call it quits. And then just focus on content, focus on wife, focus on my kid because that’s coming on the way.

On PGL’s broadcast the same evening, he had said that he has not signed anything for 2027 and expects most offers to arrive around the Major. The HLTV interview adds what happens if the right one does not. He would rather do other things than end up in a situation he does not want to be in, he said, and what he loves is the process of working towards a trophy with a team, more than the trophies themselves. “If I don’t see it happening, I’m not just going to sign a deal just to play.”

jL joined NAVI in the summer of 2023. Nine months later he was named MVP of PGL Major Copenhagen 2024, the first Major played in CS2, as NAVI lifted the trophy and he became the first Lithuanian to win a Major. He stepped away from the active lineup in July 2025, spent April and May 2026 on loan at MOUZ and left NAVI as a free agent on 1 July 2026.

Since then he has been a stand-in. At BLAST Open Porto he replaced mezii and reached the semi-finals with Vitality, and in Bucharest he fills in for apEX , who is at home for the birth of his child. He does not see the event as an audition. Even a final with this roster would not earn him much credit, he told HLTV: “It’s just Vitality, you know? They could get an academy player and still reach finals.”

title: Save the Children report urges esports to put young players’ wellbeing first
content:
Save the Children has called on the esports industry to put children's rights above competitive goals in a report titled "Protecting Child Rights in Esports," Euronews reported. For the young players who train and compete in structured scenes, the report argues that safeguards haven't kept pace with the expectations placed on them, and that their health, homelife and school life is at risk.

The charity published the report on Tuesday, asking esports to build its practices around the United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child (UNCRC). It points out that 300 million children worldwide play, and that, while esports confers advantages, such as teamwork and critical thinking under pressure, children at the moment are at risk of a wide range of issues, including anxiety, online harassment and depression, as well as disrupted sleep, musculoskeletal problems and even sexism. Children who are putting in intensive training may also fall behind at school, and their relationships with their family and friends can suffer.

Theo Toresson, a psychologist and gaming expert at Save the Children, said in a press release that "Esports offers exciting opportunities for children, but participation should never come at the expense of their rights, wellbeing or development." He added that children must be recognized "as children first and competitors second," and called for young people to have a say in decisions that affect them.

Esports can empower young people, but safeguards matter. A new report for Save the Children co-authored by @ThomasHakman @oiioxford explores 9 challenges and 9 opportunities for creating a safer future for youth esports. 📄Read the report: https://t.co/ijdKFoNzLq https://t.co/HZvtlgp3ST

The report's core worry is that children are entering competitive environments that come with the same demands put on pros … but without safeguards built specifically for their age. Poor posture over long sessions can lead to neck, shoulder, and wrist pain, which is why the report points to ergonomic guidance and better-structured practice. And while late-night schedules might be seen by some as a good way of preparing youngsters for the challenging world of pro esports, they can affect rest, mood, and cognitive performance.

One national esports federation representative, quoted anonymously in the report, said there are currently zero established guidelines on playing hours, training methods and dietary recommendations, meaning kids are essentially playing at all hours without regulated breaks. They concede that federations share advice on screen breaks, diet, sleep, and hydration, but the issue is that it’s all pieced together from various researchers, and no central body collects it.

title: Riot to pay non-partner VCT teams up to $1.1M in milestone cash from 2027
content:
Riot Games has said that any independent team in the VALORANT Champions Tour (VCT) who qualifies for major events will receive fixed cash payments, with the plans to take effect for the 2027-28 season. A team that hits every stage can collect up to $1.1 million, separate from tournament prize money, with the idea being that the open path will be more realistic for smaller, grassroots organizations.

The change arrives as Riot cuts the number of partner teams from 10 to eight per region, leaving 32 partners worldwide for 2027. In Pacific, new partners were welcomed on X by @RiotJaker , who wrote, "A huge congratulations to all our new VCT Pacific partner teams! I'm incredibly excited for the next chapter we will build together."

A huge congratulations to all our new VCT Pacific partner teams! I’m incredibly excited for the next chapter we will build together. title: Who Is Aleksib? NAVI IGL Convicted of Aggravated Tax Fraud
content:
Aleksi “Aleksib” Virolainen has found himself hitting the headlines in and out of the CS2 community recently, but for all the wrong reasons. The NAVI captain, who’s also one of the most prominent in-game leaders in Counter-Strike history, has been convicted of aggravated tax fraud in Finland. The 29-year-old was handed a four-month suspended prison sentence by the Eastern Uusimaa District Court on Tuesday, October 27.

Over the past day, this case has spread like wildfire on social media forums worldwide and garnered the attention of the entire CS2 community because of his status as a Major winner and as one of the game’s most respected IGLs.

For the unaware, Aleksib is a Finnish CS2 pro who rose to fame during his 2019 stint with ENCE, before joining OG and NAVI in the following years. He became the first Finnish player to win a CS2 Major when NAVI claimed the PGL Major Copenhagen title in March 2024. Shortly after, he earned HLTV’s IGL of the Year award, and reports estimate his career tournament earnings at around $975,641 USD across 144 tournaments.

To this day, Aleksib is playing with NAVI as the roster’s primary IGL and recently helped the org secure a first-place finish at the IEM Atlanta 2026.

Aleksib’s case revolves around payments from Valve in 2019, reportedly linked to in-game sticker sales, that were missing from his tax return. According to the ruling, roughly €53,200 went unreported, so he paid about €28,200 less tax than he owed.

Aleksib accepted that the income was left off the return, but said it was never his intention to avoid tax. His defense argued that he assumed everything was settled because tax was already being withheld from his regular salary.

title: Test Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 sur PS5 : un retour aux fondamentaux qui fait du bien
content:
Chaque année, la sortie d’un nouveau Call of Duty suscite son lot d’attentes, de débats et de comparaisons avec les épisodes précédents. La série a beau rester une référence du FPS grand public, elle n’a pas toujours réussi à renouveler sa formule sans perdre une partie de son identité. Entre les déplacements toujours plus spectaculaires, les approches parfois très éloignées du champ de bataille traditionnel et les propositions qui privilégient la surenchère, j’avais parfois eu l’impression que la franchise cherchait davantage à se réinventer qu’à perfectionner ce qu’elle savait déjà faire. Avec Modern Warfare 4, Infinity Ward semble avoir pris une direction différente : revenir à un cadre militaire contemporain, à des affrontements plus lisibles et à une action nerveuse, sans pour autant renoncer aux sensations qui ont fait le succès de la licence.

Dès mes premières parties, j’ai apprécié cette volonté de retrouver un équilibre entre efficacité arcade et crédibilité visuelle. Les soldats restent rapides, les fusillades conservent leur intensité et les affrontements peuvent basculer en quelques secondes, mais les mouvements paraissent un peu plus mesurés. Les armes ont du poids, les déplacements gagnent en cohérence et les différentes possibilités offertes sur le terrain enrichissent les combats sans transformer chaque rencontre en concours de figures acrobatiques. Le résultat n’a rien d’un simulateur militaire pur et dur, et ce n’est d’ailleurs pas ce que je lui demande. Modern Warfare 4 cherche plutôt à proposer un FPS accessible, réactif et spectaculaire, avec une identité militaire suffisamment affirmée pour se distinguer de certaines orientations plus exubérantes de la série.

Cette direction constitue à mes yeux l’une des grandes réussites de cet épisode. Le jeu ne bouleverse pas tout ce que l’on connaît de Call of Duty, mais il retravaille plusieurs éléments importants pour donner davantage de cohérence à l’ensemble. Surtout, il ne repose pas uniquement sur sa campagne pour convaincre : entre le solo, le multijoueur classique et DMZ, j’ai découvert trois expériences qui partagent les mêmes fondations tout en proposant des objectifs et des sensations suffisamment différents. Cette générosité donne à Modern Warfare 4 une vraie valeur sur la durée et explique en grande partie mon enthousiasme.

C’est par sa campagne que Modern Warfare 4 cherche d’abord à marquer les esprits, et je dois reconnaître qu’Infinity Ward a plutôt bien préparé son retour. L’aventure nous entraîne au cœur d’un conflit international impliquant notamment les deux Corées et la Russie, avec des opérations qui nous conduisent dans plusieurs grandes villes et zones de combat. De Séoul à New York, en passant par d’autres environnements urbains particulièrement soignés, le jeu multiplie les changements de décor et les situations pour éviter que l’histoire ne s’enferme dans une succession de fusillades interchangeables.

La campagne adopte surtout une approche narrative intéressante en alternant plusieurs points de vue. D’un côté, nous découvrons le conflit à travers des soldats sud-coréens, parfois encore novices, qui se retrouvent plongés dans une guerre dépassant largement leur expérience. De l’autre, Captain Price suit une trajectoire plus personnelle, guidée par une volonté de vengeance qui l’amène à remettre en question certains principes ayant longtemps défini le personnage. Cette opposition entre des combattants confrontés brutalement à la réalité du terrain et un opérateur chevronné engagé dans une affaire intime donne au récit une dimension plus humaine qu’une simple succession de missions héroïques.

J’ai particulièrement apprécié les séquences qui prennent le temps de montrer les conséquences du conflit sur les populations civiles. Modern Warfare 4 ne se contente pas d’aligner des explosions et des interventions spectaculaires : il cherche aussi à faire ressentir la violence d’une guerre qui ne touche pas uniquement les soldats présents sur le front. Certaines missions, notamment du côté nord-coréen, adoptent un ton plus sombre et mettent en scène des situations difficiles, qui contrastent efficacement avec les opérations plus classiques menées par des unités d’élite. Cette diversité de points de vue permet de renouveler l’approche du récit et donne parfois aux événements une intensité qui dépasse le simple plaisir de l’action.

title: VALORANT sera de retour à l’Esports World Cup en 2027
content:
L’Esports World Cup continue de dévoiler les jeux qui composeront son édition 2027. Dans un communiqué publié ce mardi, les organisateurs ont confirmé le retour de VALORANT pour une troisième année consécutive. Le tournoi réunira une nouvelle fois certaines des meilleures formations internationales, avec un trophée prestigieux et un cashprize conséquent à la clé. Les détails concernant les qualifications, les dates et la dotation de cette nouvelle édition n’ont toutefois pas encore été communiqués.

Cette annonce intervient alors que la scène VALORANT s’apprête à connaître une transformation majeure. En 2027, le VCT abandonnera son fonctionnement traditionnel en ligues régionales fermées au profit d’un circuit davantage ouvert, dans lequel les équipes partenaires devront elles aussi passer par des qualifications pour accéder à certaines compétitions. Un changement qui pourrait redistribuer les cartes, en offrant davantage d’opportunités aux formations issues des circuits secondaires et en renforçant la concurrence pour les places internationales.

L’édition 2026 avait été marquée par le parcours impressionnant de 100 Thieves, sacré sans perdre la moindre série. Les Nord-Américains avaient notamment éliminé MIBR, NS RedForce et NRG pour décrocher le titre, avant de confirmer leur excellente dynamique en remportant le VCT Americas Stage 2 et en terminant sur le podium des Champions. Mais en 2027, tous les regards seront également tournés vers LOUD, champion du monde en titre. Après un début de saison compliqué, la structure brésilienne avait complètement renversé la situation grâce à l’arrivée de nouveaux talents, jusqu’à remporter les Champions 2026 à Shanghai. Devenue la première organisation à décrocher deux titres mondiaux sur VALORANT avec deux effectifs entièrement différents, LOUD pourrait aborder la prochaine saison avec de grandes ambitions.

D’autres formations comme NRG, Paper Rex, Team Liquid ou encore Team Vitality pourraient également jouer les premiers rôles. Pour les structures engagées sur plusieurs jeux, l’Esports World Cup représentera aussi une occasion précieuse de marquer des points au classement général du Club Championship. Avec un circuit VCT profondément remanié et de nouveaux prétendants susceptibles d’émerger, cette édition 2027 s’annonce particulièrement ouverte.

title: Team Liquid sweep Anyone’s Legend out of Worlds 2026, ending NA’s 13-series LPL drought
content:
Team Liquid Alienware beat Anyone's Legend 2-0 to eliminate the LPL's top seed from the Worlds 2026 Swiss Stage without a game win. The result keeps the LCS champions alive and sets up a deciding series against LOS on 30 October.

Anyone’s Legend arrived at Worlds 2026 as China’s top seed. Team Liquid Alienware delivered the final blow in a series that began at 15:55 CDT.

Liquid controlled the opening game from the red side. They closed it in 33 minutes and 13 seconds with a 16-5 lead on kills. Top laner Morgan finished 7/1/6 on Camille. The second game was a far longer contest. It ran to 47 minutes before Liquid sealed the series, with Yeon’s Xayah playing a key part in the result.

For Anyone’s Legend, the defeat capped a collapse. They had already lost best-of-one matches to Karmine Corp and Top Esports before the Liquid series. Such an exit had no precedent for a Chinese top seed at Worlds, Dot Esports reported. It is also the second Worlds in a row in which the LPL’s first seed failed to get out of the Swiss Stage. Bilibili Gaming went out in Round 5 in 2025.

Anyone’s Legend and Team Secret Whales were the first two teams knocked out. Each finished joint 15th-16th and receives US$90,000 from a total prize pool of US$5,000,000. Earlier the same day, LOS had eliminated Team Secret Whales, the LCP’s top seed, with a 2-0 win that gave Brazil its first victory of the Swiss Stage.

The significance stretches beyond this tournament. Fittingly, the LCS’s previous series win over an LPL team also belonged to Team Liquid. They beat Invictus Gaming in the MSI 2019 semi-finals.

title: How to get Point Blank Kills in Modern Warfare 4
content:
There are some weapon camo challenges throughout Call of Duty history that give players the most trouble. In Modern Warfare 4 , several of these camo challenges have returned, including getting Point Blank Kills. These types of kills have long been a thorn in the side of camo grinders, but there are ways to make getting Point Blanks much easier in multiplayer.

Below, we’ll go through how to get Point Blank Kills and the best ways to go about doing so in Modern Warfare 4 multiplayer.

For starters, a Point Blank Kill is earned when you eliminate an enemy that is in extremely close proximity to you. It doesn’t matter when you damage an enemy, but when you see the kill pop up in the killfeed, you need to be within a certain range of the enemy for it to count as a Point Blank.

The exact range for a Point Blank Kill in Modern Warfare 4 is currently unknown, but we do know that it’s much closer than you might expect. In most cases, you need to be within roughly two meters of an enemy when you kill them to earn a Point Blank. This goes for all weapon classes as well, so unlike Longshot Kills , you have to be roughly two meters away even if you’re using something like a light machine gun or sniper rifle.

Now that you understand what a Point Blank Kill is, what’s the most optimal way to go about earning them in multiplayer? Well, it slightly depends on the gun you’re using, as some weapons are naturally stronger at closer ranges.

However, for the most part, you’ll want to use mobility attachments on your loadout so you can get your gun up quicker, which helps out tremendously when killing enemies at close-range. You could also go for an entirely hip-fire build and just shoot from the hip when killing enemies up close. This works best for most weapons, but you can ADS with something like an SMG or assault rifle and have the same results.

title: Aleksib Suspended Sentence Explained: What the Tax Fraud Verdict Means for NAVI’s Captain
content:
Aleksib has been given a four-month suspended prison sentence after a Finnish district court convicted the NAVI captain of aggravated tax fraud, Finnish media reported on October 27, 2026. The case covered more than €53,000 of Counter-Strike sticker income from Valve that was left off his 2019 tax return. He will not go to prison unless the suspension is broken.

The sentence matches what the prosecutor asked for and sits at the bottom of the legal range for the offence. Here is what Aleksib was found guilty of, what his defence argued and what the verdict means for his career.

Aleksi “Aleksib” Virolainen, 29, was convicted of aggravated tax fraud over income he received from Valve in the 2019 tax year. According to the charges heard at the Eastern Uusimaa District Court, he did not return his pre-filled 2019 tax return, and the Valve payments were missing from it.

The prosecution said that left more than €53,000 of taxable income undeclared and caused his income tax to be assessed more than €28,000 too low. The offence period in the charge runs from May 19 to September 22, 2020, in Vantaa, the window in which the 2019 return was handled.

The money came from Counter-Strike sticker sales. At Valve’s Majors, players and teams get a share of revenue from in-game stickers sold in their name. In 2019, Aleksib played two Majors with ENCE and reached the grand final of IEM Katowice 2019.

No, not under this verdict. A suspended sentence means the prison term is not served as long as the person meets the conditions the court sets and does not commit a new offence during the probation period. The verdict reports we reviewed did not say how long Aleksib’s probation period is.

title: Valve tells indie developers to beat AI clones with community and steady Steam updates
content:
Valve's Steam Business Team told developers worried about AI-made clone games to stop worrying and to instead put that energy into building a community and shipping regular updates. By doing so, they will build the kind of rapport and goodwill with gamers that cloned games can’t compete with. The advice came at the Steam Indie Connect event on Oct. 27, and it’s especially prevalent for indie studios who currently have to sit back and watch as low-effort releases flood the market.

The event was co-hosted by Valve , the Busan Indie Connect Festival Organizing Committee, and the Korea Creative Content Agency (KOCCA). Tom Giardino and Marc Wilkinson of the Steam Business Team presented, and Matt from Valve's localization team joined the Q&A.

Brutal reality of making 500K on Steam as a game dev https://t.co/pYEd0Hxd1U

Valve's argument is simple: yes, a single mechanic can be cloned quickly, but the core features that foster a genuine connection with players can’t be copied the same way. Making the genuine version the best version has long been Valve's guiding principle, the team said. If developers renew their efforts here, they can only lose to better games that are also made by humans.

On the use of AI itself, Giardino was adamant that he won’t tell developers what they can and can’t do. It’s entirely up to them. "We don't want to be gatekeepers telling developers which tools they should or shouldn't use," he said. Whether to use AI in development, in Valve's view, is the developer's call.

One developer in the Q&A asked about extortion-style emails threatening to clone a game with AI and release it first. Giardino said it was the first time he'd heard of such cases and expressed his regret.

title: Valve on Steam AI Slop: No AI Filter, and AI Clone Extortion Is a Police Matter

Valve’s position fits in four points. It will not police which development tools studios use, AI included. It sees AI clones as an old problem that AI has sped up. Giardino’s advice to developers worried about copycats was to build a community and keep updating the game. He tied that to Valve’s long-standing approach to piracy: avoid aggressive DRM and make the legitimate version the best version.

title: jL meets his old team, and Aleksib says NAVI never celebrated their Singapore place

For jL , the opponent is personal. He joined NAVI in the summer of 2023, and nine months later he was the MVP of PGL Major Copenhagen, the first Lithuanian to win a Major. Aleksib , iM , b1t and w0nderful won it with him, and all four are still in the lineup. HLTV ranked jL as the fifth-best player of 2024.

The split came gradually. jL took a voluntary break in July 2025, spent April and May of this year on loan at MOUZ , and became a free agent when he left NAVI on 1 July after three years. Six matches for Vitality at BLAST Open Porto followed, and so did a clear answer to the question of a return. On the BLAST analysis desk in September, he said NAVI looked too static and were “trying to play too perfect CS”, and that he had not left in order to come back.

Vitality did not meet NAVI in Porto, so Tuesday is the first time he lines up against them.

jL is in Bucharest because apEX is at home for the birth of his child, and the count matters beyond this event. Valve’s Regional Standings only list players who have played five of a team’s last ten matches, so five matches in Bucharest would put jL in apEX’s place on the roster Vitality are invited with to PGL Major Singapore. title: Roaring Bears will leave their colours at home for IEM Cologne 2027 over ESL’s ticket prices
content:
Roaring Bears, the German fan club known for its organised support at BIG’s matches, will not appear as a group at IEM Cologne 2027. The club blames ESL’s ticket pricing and what it calls the growing commercialisation of the event, and it has asked fans who still go to the LANXESS Arena to leave its merchandise at home.

The decision came on Monday evening, three and a half weeks after the club first said it was considering staying away. It is not a call for a boycott. Roaring Bears stress that every fan can decide for themselves whether to travel to Cologne, and that some of their own members may still make the trip. What disappears is the organised, recognisable block in the stands. The statement, posted in German and English:

After careful consideration, we the Roaring Bears have made a decision: we will not be attending as the Roaring Bears in a recognizable fashion. We want to make it clear that we will not tell anyone whether they should attend IEM or travel to Cologne, nor will we judge anyone for doing so. That is everyone’s own decision, and we respect that. However, under the current circumstances, we do not feel comfortable attending the event as usual.

No Bears at #IEM Cologne 2027 Link zum Text in den Kommis 🔽 Text below 🔽 pic.twitter.com/mxNI9vgkmQ

The club is considering an alternative programme, but nothing has been decided yet. Its one request goes to everyone who does attend:

If you attend the event at the LANXESS Arena, please refrain from wearing Roaring Bears merchandise. We do not want our name and colors to be represented at an event whose current ticket pricing and increasing commercialization we strongly criticize. We believe that Counter-Strike should be accessible to everyone, not just those who can afford increasingly expensive tickets.

title: Worlds 2026 : la Karmine Corp épargnée par le tirage, deux monstres pour KOI et G2 !
content:
Après trois journées riches en surprises, le Swiss Stage entre dans une phase décisive. La Karmine Corp peut notamment s’estimer relativement chanceuse après le tirage au sort de ce quatrième tour. Battus successivement par LYON et Bilibili Gaming, les Français retrouveront CTBC Flying Oyster, formation taïwanaise également en 1-2, ce jeudi 29 octobre à 21h. Un adversaire qui semble plus abordable sur le papier que certains autres prétendants, mais qui avait notamment créé la surprise face à Team Liquid en ouverture du tournoi. Pour Caliste et ses coéquipiers, l’équation est simple : une victoire pour rester en vie, une défaite et l’aventure mondiale prendra fin.

Le tirage a été nettement moins clément avec Movistar KOI et G2 Esports. Toujours en course pour une qualification directe en quarts de finale avec un bilan de 2-1, les Espagnols devront affronter T1, champion du monde en titre, dès mercredi à 21h. Un défi immense pour la bande à Elyoya, qui reste sur une lourde défaite contre Dplus KIA. De son côté, G2 n’aura pas le droit à l’erreur face à Hanwha Life Esports, champion du MSI 2026 et autre grand favori de la compétition. Les deux équipes, actuellement en 1-2, joueront leur survie dans un BO3 programmé le 30 octobre à minuit, dans la nuit de vendredi.

Dans les autres rencontres du tableau à 2-1, Invictus Gaming affrontera LYON, tandis que Top Esports retrouvera Bilibili Gaming dans un choc 100 % chinois. Les vainqueurs de ces trois BO3 rejoindront Gen.G et Dplus KIA en quarts de finale, alors que les perdants devront disputer un cinquième et dernier tour pour tenter de se qualifier.

Enfin, le tableau des équipes en 1-2 proposera également une confrontation entre Team Liquid et LOS, deux formations qui ont sauvé leur peau lors de la troisième journée. Comme pour la Karmine Corp et G2, la moindre défaite sera synonyme d’élimination. Ce quatrième tour pourrait donc déjà sceller le sort de plusieurs grands noms de la compétition, avant l’ultime journée du Swiss Stage.

Toutes les rencontres se disputeront en BO3.

content:
The gap between Acts 1 and 2 of the Dark Carnival event in Dota 2 has exceeded Crownfall’s longest wait between acts, with players still waiting for Valve to release the next chapter of the ongoing story.

The first part of Dark Carnival, titled Midnight Run, launched on June 25, 2026. As of October 27, 124 days have passed since its release, exceeding the 121-day gap between Crownfall Acts 3 and 4 in 2024.

Reddit user LightningInTheRain highlighted the growing wait in a discussion on the Dota 2 subreddit on Oct. 22. The post pointed out that Dark Carnival was approaching Crownfall ‘s previous record, prompting players to guess the time when Valve would release the next part of the event.

The Reddit discussion attracted hundreds of upvotes, with players sharing their theories and frustrations about the delay and what Valve might have planned for the next update.

title: Team Yandex takes down Team Liquid to claim the top spot in Group A in PARI Universe
content:
Despite suffering their first match loss at PARI Universe, Team Yandex bounced back in Game 3 to overwhelm Team Liquid, securing first place in Group A and a favorable playoff position.

The series became a must-see for many fans, as this is the first time that Ammar “ATF” Al-Assaf will fight against his former teammate from Team Falcons, Stanislav “Malr1ne” Potorak. Malr1ne recently took a post TI 15 break, and upon his return, he joined Team Liquid after the departure of Michał “Nisha” Jankowski from the organization.

The highly anticipated matchup between ATF and Malr1ne at PARI Universe featured plenty of playful banter, with both players tipping each other and exchanging in-game chat messages during teamfights. Their antics were reminiscent of their usual behavior when they played together on Team Falcons, which has drawn mixed reactions from the Dota 2 community.

However, throughout the best-of-three (Bo3) series, Team Yandex appeared to have the upper hand, with the roster delivering the kind of performance that few teams in the world can match. Unlike Team Liquid, who suffered consecutive losses against GamerLegion and OG, Team Yandex looked to be in top form, having remained undefeated in the tournament before this series.

Team Yandex quickly decimated Team Liquid in Game 1, courtesy of Alimzhan “watson” Islambekov’s Kez with 14 kills and 35.6k damage. In Game 2, ATF used his classic Huskar in an attempt to close the series, but Team Liquid successfully neutralized it with a Naix-Earthshaker combo.

Team Yandex decided to give ATF’s Huskar another shot, this time pairing it with a mid-lane Invoker and carry Tiny. Team Liquid’s lineup had limited options for soaking up damage, with carry Lifestealer (Naix) being the only hero capable of taking heavy hits. Unable to withstand Team Yandex’s burst damage, Team Liquid called GG in under 30 minutes.

title: RLCS : Extra reste fidèle à la Karmine Corp, le retour d’un duo légendaire

La reconstruction de la Karmine Corp sur Rocket League prend forme. Selon les informations de Sheep Esports , Alexandre « Extra » Paoli devrait conserver son poste d’entraîneur principal pour la saison RLCS 2027. Un choix important pour l’organisation française, contrainte de revoir entièrement ses plans après les départs attendus d’Atow et Vatira vers Gentle Mates. Extra avait lui-même discuté avec cette dernière structure pour suivre ses anciens joueurs, avant de finalement privilégier la continuité avec la KC.

Arrivé à la Karmine Corp après avoir pris sa retraite de joueur en 2025, le Français de 24 ans sort d’une première saison réussie sur le banc. Sous sa direction, la KC a notamment remporté le Major de Paris et atteint le dernier carré des Worlds 2026. Mais son maintien prend une dimension particulière avec l’arrivée attendue d’Evan « M0nkey M00n » Rogez, son ancien coéquipier chez Team BDS. Ensemble, les deux Français avaient remporté les Worlds RLCS 2021-2022, avant de marquer durablement l’histoire de la scène compétitive. Ils pourraient désormais se retrouver dans une configuration inédite, avec Extra dans le rôle d’entraîneur et M0nkey M00n comme leader sur le terrain.

Après avoir envisagé un retrait de Rocket League durant l’intersaison, la Karmine Corp aurait finalement choisi de miser sur un mélange d’expérience et de jeunesse. M0nkey M00n devrait être accompagné d’Attila « bibbaba » Eötvös et de reyyn, deux joueurs de seulement 16 ans, encore peu expérimentés au plus haut niveau. Un pari ambitieux, mais qui permettrait aux deux espoirs d’évoluer aux côtés d’un double champion du monde, sous les ordres d’un entraîneur qui connaît parfaitement son jeu.

Cette nouvelle équipe aurait pour mission de tourner la page d’un effectif historique, également marqué par le départ attendu de juicy vers Geekay Esports. La KC devrait faire ses premiers pas avec ce trio lors du RLCS Kick-Off de Londres en décembre, une compétition à laquelle elle est invitée en tant qu’organisation partenaire. Après une intersaison mouvementée, le club français semble donc avoir trouvé les bases de son nouveau projet, avec des ambitions à reconstruire autour du duo Extra – M0nkey M00n.

title: Razer controllers will power Rocket League student finals at FUSE Esports Festival
content:
Student finalists in the State and National Rocket League Finals will play on high-end Razer controllers used by professional players this November, after the hardware brand became the Official Controller Partner of Australian school esports operator The FUSE Cup. The Rocket League decider is the capstone of a school year of qualifiers.

The FUSE Cup's Chief Operating Officer, Daniel Aivaliotis-Martinez, shared the news in an announcement post on LinkedIn , which he used to speak about creating meaningful experiences for young people before thanking the Razer team for their support and belief in what the FUSE Cup is building. Razer gear, which is used by esports pros around the world, as well as actual world champions, will now be in the hands of every finalist competing for the national title.

The controllers themselves come with 2.4GHz wireless technology that prevents lag, toggleable physical triggers and back paddles.

The partnership has two parts: finalists get Razer controllers for the State and National Rocket League Finals, which means players won’t have to bring their own pads to the biggest series of their school careers.

Secondly, Razer is sponsoring the Student Leadership Award, a new category at the FUSE Australian School Esports Awards. It's aimed at pupils who make a positive contribution to their community and show leadership inside their school's esports program. It means the brand is also putting itself on a prize that has nothing to do with winning matches.

The FUSE Esports Festival sees itself as Australia's largest in-person school esports festival. It’s backed by the City of Gold Coast council, and it takes place at Southern Cross University.

title: Call of Duty: Black Ops II Is Among the Best-Selling Games of 2026, 14 Years After Launch
content:
Call of Duty: Black Ops II, a game that first launched in November 2012, is the sixth best-selling game of 2026 in the US so far. Circana’s year-to-date chart through September puts it ahead of Forza Horizon 6, Tomodachi Life and Pokemon Pokopia, almost entirely on the back of the PS4 and PS5 port that Activision released on July 9. Those new PlayStation versions sent a 14-year-old shooter to the top of the US monthly chart in July.

Here is where it sits, how it got there so fast and why it matters for Call of Duty.

These are Circana’s projected US best-sellers for January to September 2026, ranked by dollar sales across physical and full-game digital purchases. Mobile games and add-on content are not counted.

Marvel’s Wolverine, which topped September after launching mid-month, sits 11th for the year. We covered that launch and the PS5 hardware bump in our September Circana breakdown .

Because PlayStation owners could not buy it before July. Black Ops II originally came out on PS3, Xbox 360, PC and Wii U, and the PS3 version never ran on PS4 or PS5. Xbox players kept access through backward compatibility, and PC players through Steam. Anyone on a modern PlayStation was locked out for over a decade.

Activision fixed that on July 9 with surprise PS4 and PS5 releases of both Black Ops and Black Ops II. Treyarch and Iron Galaxy handled the ports. Each game includes the campaign, multiplayer and Zombies, while the original map packs are sold separately through a season pass. Launch pricing was $19.99 per game until August 6, after which the standard price became $39.99.

title: Nintendo Pulls SmileBASIC 4 as Tethered Switch 2 Jailbreak ns2jb Appears

title: Fortnite Wins Australian Court Battle, Reclaims Spot on iOS
content:
Fortnite returns to iOS in Australia on October 22, 2026, after the Federal Court of Australia ruled against Apple in the Epic Games antitrust case. Justice Jonathan Beach found that Apple broke competition law by limiting app distribution and payment options. Epic announced the return on X, and Apple plans to appeal. The court also ordered Apple to open iOS to third-party app stores and alternative payments by March 1, 2027.

The return follows a ruling that Apple violated Australian competition law. The court found that Apple restricted how apps are distributed and how users pay inside them. It also ordered Apple to readmit Fortnite and other Epic apps once Epic sends a written request. Readmission stays subject to App Store rules that match the court’s orders.

Epic CEO Tim Sweeney reacted on X after the remedies were issued. He called the outcome a “huge victory for consumers and developers” and said Epic is studying the verdict. He added that more details will follow.

title: All Police Station locations in Modern Warfare 4 DMZ

title: How to find and open a Safe in Modern Warfare 4 DMZ
content:
Throughout your career in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 DMZ, you’ll continually get to complete DMZ Orders, which are specific tasks that earn you rewards the more you complete them. While some of the DMZ Orders are simple, others can be rather difficult, and one of the more challenging ones is to “Open a Safe.”

While this sounds trivial at first glance, you then realize that Safes aren’t too common to find on the Hajin map in DMZ. Luckily, though, we know of some dedicated spots for Safes that allow you to complete this DMZ Order with no problem at all.

For us, this specific DMZ Order was on Page 5, and it even says that you can find Safes in Compounds and Locked Spaces . Of course, that doesn’t help a lot, as you still need to go out and search for these locations and then locate the Safe itself.

While you might have some serious trouble trying to find a “Locked Space,” you shouldn’t have many problems locating a Compound. These are marked by a tent icon on your Tac-Map and are fairly common in Hajin, particularly out in the woodlands or the side roads in between the major points of interest on the map.

In order to open a Safe in a Compound, you need to enter it and then clear out 100% of the enemy AI from the area . This is tracked by a percentage meter that appears on the left side of your screen when you enter a Compound. There are usually around 10-12 enemies in each Compound, and when they’re all cleared out, your meter will read 100%.

From here, you need to find the Safe that the Compound has stashed. For the most part, the Safe is located at the top of the guard tower, which is found at most Compounds . Just climb the stairs to get to the top, and you’ll find the Safe sitting on the ground next to a desk. Interact with it, loot the contents, and you’ll get a mission completion for this DMZ Order.
